_comment: What the copilot's release test pass checks, per dimension. Built from the release testing guide's priorities: debugging, developer menu, TextInput, lists and keyboard interactions, plus app launch and Fast Refresh. Each case lists its checks. 'maestro' runs a flow from ../maestro/, 'script' is a check release-test.mjs runs itself, 'agent' is the copilot reading the screenshot and recording a verdict with `release-test.mjs confirm`. A case passes only when every check it lists passes. Cases from the crew's test spreadsheet go in `spreadsheet` once someone can share it.

cases.title: App launches and renders its first screen from Metro

checks.look: The app's first screen rendered: RNTester shows the Components list, RNTestProject shows 'Welcome to React Native'. No red error screen, no yellow warning banner, no blank screen.

cases.title: Hermes debugger target is reachable and evaluates JavaScript
Developer menu opens with its standard items

checks.look: The React Native developer menu is open and lists Reload, Open DevTools, Toggle Element Inspector, Disable Fast Refresh and Show Perf Monitor.

cases.title: Reload from the developer menu brings the app back
Editing a component hot-updates it without a full reload

checks.look: The screen shows the edited text 'Fast Refresh release check' and nothing else looks broken.

cases.title: TextInput takes focus and typed text

checks.look: The text field shows 'release test' with the cursor in it and the on-screen keyboard is up.

cases.title: Keyboard dismisses on submit and keeps the typed text

checks.look: The keyboard is gone and the field still shows 'release test'.
A FlatList of numbered items is on screen, scrolled past the first items, with no gaps or overlapping rows.
